main_text.p: In institutione Baptismi, cuius hæc sunt verba: Ite & docete omnes gentes, baptizantes eos in nomine Patris, & Filii, & S.S.{a} Qui crediderit & baptizatus fuerit, seruabitur: qui non crediderit, condemnabitur{b}. Hæc promissio repetitur, cum scriptura Baptismum nominat lauacrum regenerationis{c} & ablutionem peccatorum{d}?Mat.28.19Mar.16.16Tit.3.5Act.22.16

p.i: Estne ergo externus Baptismus aquæ, ipsa peccatorum ablutio?

main_text.p: Non est:{e} Nam solus sanguis Jesu Christi purgat nos ab omni peccato{f}.Mat.3.11. 1.Pet.3.21. Eph.5.26.1.Io 1.7. 2.Cor.6.11.

p.i: Cur ergo Sp.S. Baptismum appellat lauacrum regenerationis, & ablutionem peccatorum?

main_text.p: Deus non sine graui causa sic loquitur, videlicet non solùm vt nos doceat, quemadmodum sordes corporis aqua purgantur: sic peccata nostra sanguine & Spiritu Christi expiari{g}. Verùm multò magis, vt nobis hoc diuino Symbolo, ac pignore certum faciat nos non minùs verè à peccatis nostris interna lotione ablui, quàexterna&visibili aqua abluti sumus{h}.Apoc.1.5. & 7.14. 1.cor.6.11.Mar.16.16. Gal.3.17 [?]

Omnino: Nam cùm æque ac adulti ad fœdus & Eccl. Dei pertineant{i}, cumque eis per sanguinem Christi, remissio peccatorum{k} & S.S. fidei effector, non minùs quàm in adultis promittatur{l}; per Baptismum Ecclesiæ Dei inferendi sùt, & ab infidelium liberis discernendi, {m}itidem vt in Veteri fœdere, per circumcisionem fiebat{n}, cui in Nouo fœdere substitu-Gen.17.7.Mat.19.14.Lu.1.14. 15. Pf.22.11. If.44. 1.2.3. Act.2.9.Act.10.47.Gc.17.14.

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "Gal.3.17" (the numeral may be 27); "Mat.3.11" (may be 5.11). The note under "l" combines several bare references printed in one column, with "15." and "1.2.3." assigned to it by position. "Gc.17.14" is printed as "Gc" and is left as printed. The catchword "tus" is the completion of "substitutus" set at the lower right. The printed "{m}" mark is set in front of "itidem" in the scan. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout, and the "vifibili" reading is given as "visibili" because the letterform is ambiguous.
